note: Decks for reel-callout.html. Copy is a bit. It is not a reading of anyone's chart, and each notes.md says so. Voice rules are BRAND_DESIGN_BIBLE section 4 and CONTENT_SYSTEM section 3: lowercase, specific, no em dashes, never teaches first.

hook: not the sun sign. the one that actually texts.
moon-2am.sub: ur moon sign is on ur chart, not on ur birthday.

cta.p: the sun sign is the press release. the moon is the 2am draft.

cards.line: u up? no reason.
cards.sub: there is a reason. it is from 2021 and it is still open.

cards.line: i'm not upset. i'm just not going to speak.
cards.sub: has been composing this silence since march.

cards.line: ok so hear me out (voice note, 9 min)
cards.sub: sent it. immediately sent a second one correcting the first.

cards.line: do people actually like me or are they being nice
cards.sub: will ask again on thursday. will not accept the answer.

cards.line: i'm so over it btw. anyway did u see my story
cards.sub: the story was posted for one person. u know the one.

cards.line: i made a list of everything i did wrong
cards.sub: the list is numbered. item 4 is from a group project in 2019.

cards.line: ok but whose side are u on. be honest.
cards.sub: does not want honest. wants a co-signature.

cards.line: i found their cousin's finsta
cards.sub: took eleven minutes. will bring it up in four months.

cards.line: what if i just moved to goa
cards.sub: the tab is open. the tab has been open since june.

cards.line: i'm fine. i have a plan. it is four years long.
cards.sub: the plan has a spreadsheet. the spreadsheet has no crying column.

cards.line: genuinely i don't need anyone
cards.sub: typed this to a person. at 2:47am. on purpose.

cards.line: sorry ignore that. sorry. sorry.
cards.sub: apologised three times for a message that was completely fine.

moon-2am.title: ur moon sign at 2am

moon-2am.caption:
ur sun sign is the press release. ur moon sign is the 2am draft 🌙

the moon is where u actually live when nobody is watching: how u panic, who u text, what u apologise for. it is not ur birthday sign. it is a separate placement, in a separate rashi, and most people have never checked it.

group-chat.kicker: the gossip desk · nine grahas · one chat
hook: all nine are in there. one of them is u.
group-chat.sub: which one u are is on ur chart, not on vibes.

cta.p: u already know who it is. u thought of them on slide three.

cards.line: picks the place, the time and the plan
cards.sub: did not ask. the poll was decorative.

cards.line: asks if everyone got home ok, at 1am
cards.sub: also the one who leaves on read for two days without noticing.

cards.line: replies 'say less. leaving now.'
cards.sub: is already in the auto. nobody confirmed anything.

cards.line: nine voice notes. none of them under four minutes.
cards.sub: sends the summary after u have already listened to all nine.

cards.line: gives the advice she is not taking herself
cards.sub: correct every single time. about other people.

cards.line: books the place, then splits the bill wrong
cards.sub: the place was beautiful. u paid for someone's starter.

cards.line: says we should all go home and sleep
cards.sub: right. hated for it. correct anyway.

cards.line: screenshots absolutely everything
cards.sub: has a folder. the folder has subfolders. u are in one of them.

cards.line: exited the group in 2023 and never explained
cards.sub: resurfaces once a year to react to one message with a heart.

group-chat.title: ur group chat, by graha
group-chat.summary: nine grahas as nine people in one group chat, ending on a tag prompt.
group-chat.caption:
every group chat has all nine grahas in it 🦜

this is actually how jyotish thinks about them. the grahas are not lucky rocks in the sky, they are nine jobs: one decides, one feels, one moves, one talks, one advises, one spends, one limits, one grabs, one leaves. ur chart says which of those nine is running the show in ur life right now.

u thought of a specific person for at least four of these.

send it to ur rahu. and to ur ketu, if they are still reachable 💀

the-ick.kicker: the love desk · icks filed · no appeal
hook: venus is what u want. it is also what puts u off.
the-ick.sub: ur venus sign is on ur chart. it is not ur sun sign.

cta.p: the ick and the crush are the same placement, running in both directions.

cards.line: said 'let's be spontaneous' and drove to a mall
cards.sub: wants the rush. does not want the plan that makes a rush possible.

cards.line: suggested the same restaurant. for the fourth time.
cards.sub: this is loyalty. it is also why nothing has changed since 2021.

cards.line: told me my own story back to me on thursday
cards.sub: collects material. does not always file where it came from.

cards.line: brought up his ex to explain why he is careful now
cards.sub: the past is furniture here. he will not be moving it.

cards.line: checked his reflection in the metro door. twice.
cards.sub: needs to be seen. the door counts as an audience.

cards.line: corrected how i said the name of a pasta
cards.sub: thinks precision is a love language. it is a hobby.

cards.line: said 'whatever u want' then sulked about what i wanted
cards.sub: wanted to be asked twice. will not tell u that.

cards.line: asked who i was texting. it was my mother.
cards.sub: intensity is the draw. it is also the whole problem.

cards.line: said he doesn't believe in labels. at a wedding.
cards.sub: means it. also would like u to stay. both, somehow.

cards.line: sent a calendar invite for the date. with an agenda.
cards.sub: this is affection. it has simply been through procurement.

cards.line: explained my own job to me at a party
cards.sub: loves an idea. is still learning that u are not one.

cards.line: cried at an ad, then forgot my birthday
cards.sub: feels everything. retains almost none of it.

the-ick.title: the ick, by venus sign
the-ick.summary: twelve venus signs, twelve icks, then comment ur venus. the sequel format to moon 2am.
the-ick.caption:
the ick is a venus thing 🚩

venus is not just who u fancy. it is what u find attractive, what u spend on, what u put up with, and the exact thing that ends it for u at dinner. same placement, running in both directions.

it is also not ur sun sign. venus is its own placement in its own rashi, and it moves fast enough that people born days apart have different ones.

birth-weekday.kicker: the vara desk · seven days · one graha each
hook: seven days, seven grahas. this is the one placement u already know.
birth-weekday.sub: vara: the weekday lord. real jyotish, and no chart needed to find urs.

cards.line: cannot be in a room without ending up in charge of it
cards.sub: surya does not do side quests and it does not do anonymous. the day wants credit, and it has usually earned it.

cards.line: mood is a weather system and everyone else lives downwind
cards.sub: chandra changes sign every two and a half days. so do u, and u have quietly decided that is everyone else's problem.

cards.line: sent it. read it back. sent another one.
cards.sub: mangal does not let a draft cool down. it is the speed that wins the argument and the speed that pays for it later.

cards.line: has argued both sides. in the same conversation. convincingly.
cards.sub: budha is the negotiator. unbeatable in a meeting, exhausting in a relationship, and genuinely not sure which one it meant.

cards.line: gives advice nobody asked for and is annoyingly right
cards.sub: guru is the teacher of the chart. the trouble with a teacher is that class never actually ends.

cards.line: will not leave in the wrong outfit. will leave the country on a whim.
cards.sub: shukra wants it beautiful before it wants it sensible. a very good eye and a very expensive one.

cards.line: old since nine. tired since twelve. correct since about now.
cards.sub: shani makes u wait for every single thing and then hands it over permanently. slowest start in the week, longest run.

cta.p: not the date. the day of the week. that is the graha that has been running ur week since u got here.

birth-weekday.title: the day of the week u were born
birth-weekday.summary: seven varas, seven grahas, one comment prompt with zero lookup cost. the weekday lord is the only placement an audience can answer instantly, which is the whole reason this one exists.
birth-weekday.caption:
the day of the week u were born has a graha attached to it, and nobody told u 🦜

this is vara, the weekday lord. it is the oldest working piece of jyotish and it is the only placement u do not have to look up, because u already know it.

sunday is surya. monday is chandra. tuesday is mangal. wednesday is budha. thursday is guru. friday is shukra. saturday is shani.

ur sun sign is a horoscope column. ur vara is a schedule. it is why some weeks feel like they are being run by somebody else, and which somebody that is.

comment ur birth day 👇 not the date, the day. and if u do not know it, that is what the app is for.
